idea-plugin.name: FITS Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
View FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) files directly in PyCharm and other JetBrains IDEs.

  • Image viewer with linear, log, square-root and asinh stretches and matplotlib colour maps
  • Interactive histogram for setting black/white levels
  • Zoom around the cursor and drag to pan, with keyboard shortcuts
  • Pixel value and RA/Dec readout under the cursor, magnifier and distance measurement
  • Header browser with filtering, for every HDU in the file
  • Export the displayed image as PNG
  • Multi-extension files, tile-compressed images (.fz) and data cubes

Large images are read lazily and downsampled for display, so even big files open without exhausting IDE memory.
